character_data.text:
神秘学家艺术品，展出于20世纪80年代，参展时长22年，诞生自2月13日冬。展出地点为爱琴海区域某岛。

尺寸：69 17/32×21 29/64×14 11/64in.
介质：平衡
香调：木质调 冷杉 焚香 龙涎香 水
灵感：洞穴的智者[智] 智慧传承

character_data.title: 冠
character_data.text: 一顶友人们所赠予的头冠，金属锻造，简洁，光亮如新，显然受到了特殊的优待。据受访者所称，其作为饰品的显著“意义”是令他的额头卷入锐角与皮肉的纷争。为免于此，它一般被用于压书。

character_data.title: 经
character_data.text: 数个陈旧的卷轴，构造遵循古制，纸张粗糙，推测为早期造纸工艺所作，不便写作。它的整洁令我们对其中内容相当好奇。遗憾的是，当我们试图探究其中的手绘涂画时，受访者出乎意料地发动了神秘术。

character_data.title: 形式
character_data.text: 数个相互联结的六边形，结构与排列十分独特，似乎隐含着某种不言自明的秩序。“理论上这象征着完满，”受访者如是说，“不过它被海鸥叼走了太多次，连接处已经严重磨损了。”

character_data.title: 取道毕达哥拉斯
character_data.text:
崇奉者专事教务，论理者深究思辨，形而下学者感悟自然，政事者体察社会。循着真理，毕达哥拉斯的弟子们各行其是。由此，他们也攫住了许多或鄙夷、或向往的目光。

沉默，守秘。正如神秘学家与人类关于理性与灵知之间的矛盾高墙，另一道名为“戒律”的鸿沟也决然而长久地将毕达哥拉斯的信众与旁人分离开来。

“不许坐于量器”，“不许跳跃牛轭”，“不许以刀剑拨火”……原始而古老的诫命显而易见地拦下了绝大部分的好事之徒，而只有真心敬重真理的听讲者，才会明白背后的真意。“尊重永恒的诸神，敬守你的誓言”，“敬拜卓越的英雄”，“尽你所能，以免于他者的强迫”……

千百年过去，最初的教派早已毁灭，古老的学说濒临失传，信徒们被迫卷入世间无尽的纷争，在生之巨轮的裹挟中徒劳流转。但仍有一小支传道者们在不倦地颂读《金言》。他们开辟道路，建立学派，吸纳信者。他们承袭了数代的智慧与学识，唯一的使命，便是将人们领上更光明的真理之路。

而今，又一位年轻的传道者接过了这份责任。

character_data.title: 岛的义务
character_data.text:
“我们每日沐浴阿波罗星的晨光，咀嚼他人与自我的探讨与思辨，令它们与抹有蜂蜜的面包片一同在腹中消化……”面有难色的教众捂着肚子，表情看上去相当压抑。
“可我的头脑仍然昏沉，肚子也时不时地发出鸣响……”他紧张地望着面前的领袖，“这意味着什么呢？难道我对他人的话语连半点儿共鸣都不曾发生吗？”
“寻得智慧并非一日之功，29。”领袖温和地笑了笑，“哪怕是最为出色的教众，也无法在所有的宣读会中都有所收获。”
“如果我一直这样，我便无法与他人有更深的交流……”他的忧虑显然还没有完全消弭，“难道我正如数字的谶言一般，是一个没有朋友的纯粹质数吗？”
“真理的殿堂没有这样的谶语，令它引领你，而非成为你的桎梏。”
“可是……我应该做些什么呢？”他的焦虑似乎减少了几分。
“一切都会在平衡中自然地抵达，29。无论在何种时候。”
对方终于长舒了一口气，面色欣喜地离开了。

年轻的领袖合上了卷牍，他展开了一卷新的纸页，若有所思地叹了口气。
——即日起，应增补部分教众的面包片份额。

character_data.title: 领袖的心声
character_data.text:
6：你是……？
白雪松：请原谅《UTTU》的不请自来。我很好奇，在正式的谈话开始前，你是否预想过与我们的这一次会面？
6：诚实起见，不。
白雪松：令人遗憾，这似乎并不是个恰当的时机。
白雪松：你还愿意配合我们的采访吗？
6：这取决于你的意愿。
6：正如与教众的每一次释惑，在偶现的灵光一闪时，他们也会如此敲响我的房门。
6：而我会予以应尽的回答。
白雪松：你是位尽职的领袖。
6：这是我的义务。
白雪松：从形式上来说，采访和解惑确实颇为相似。
白雪松：但我们的内容或许会更加直白，或者说，锋利。
6：无妨。请享用你的权利。
白雪松：……那么，你了解《UTTU》吗？
6：不了解。
白雪松：……我预感，这的确会是一场相当直白的访谈。
白雪松：顺带一提，你刚才进入房间时的步伐似乎远比进入传道者之厅时轻快。
6：……
白雪松：据我的猜测，这出于某种更有趣的原因，而非出于对《UTTU》访谈的期盼。

character_data.title: 深色大雨衣
character_data.text:
拥有大胆用色与前卫设计的时尚风衣。由于长时间缺乏保养，其价值很容易被忽略。
高档衣裳从不青睐雨点，好在它生来便接受如此命运。

character_data.title: “相反的数字”
character_data.text:
一副平常的手套，上面写有代表受访者的数字，显然也可以被从另一种角度解读。
据悉，在某些语境中，平衡的翻转便代表谜团。

character_data.title: 白色铁面
character_data.text:
一副漆成白色的铁面具，用以遮掩面具下的另一副面具。
关于这副装扮的真相，外人不得而知。一切都为谜团所包围，消失在每一个雨夜中。

character_data.title: 明光之于黄金
character_data.text: 仿古波斯风格的黄金饰品，形似翼羽，色如明光。在问及其价值时，受访者称：“它并非此次出行中最为贵重之物。”在我们追问何为更贵重之物时，受访者展示了一份尚未完成的复原手稿。

character_data.title: 冷火之于信徒
character_data.text:
一簇跃动于受访者右臂的火焰，留存其洁净之形，抛却其灼烧之苦。
对于“这是否算是一种置身其中的智慧”的提问，受访者不置可否。

character_data.title: 明灭之于花朵
character_data.text:
一盏留有少量余蜡的烛台。受访者将其点燃，又复而将其熄灭。
“重要的并非火焰本身，就本质而言，这簇火焰与千年之前的火焰并无区别；焚毁此地的火焰，也与为此地所赞颂的火焰并无不同。”

character_data.title: “仅能照亮自我”
character_data.text:
提灯的光芒并不强烈，只能勉强驱散脚下两三米内的黑暗，其效果甚至比十利齿子儿一个的煤油灯还微弱。
受访者常常向其中探视。笔者询问受访者能从中看见什么，受访者如此回答：“他人好奇的表情。”

character_data.title: 真理之杖
character_data.text:
一根名叫“真理”的手杖，支撑的并非肉体，而是灵魂。或许将之称为“经验”更加合适。
在漫长的精神旅程中，他所能倚靠的唯有自己的、前人的，以及前人的前人的经验。

character_data.title: “孤独的茧”
character_data.text:
一席神圣的斗篷，将人隔离在世俗之外。
受访者没有露出一丝脖颈以下的皮肤，或许剥离触觉等种种感受也是修行的一种。

character_voice.encontent: I start reading at this time of day and finish it as dusk falls. #0|This has become a soothing habit of mine in this long, weary journey to the final end.#4.4

character_voice.jpcontent: 今から書見を始め、夕暮れが訪れるまで読みます。#0|長い時間の中で、いつしか書見は私の習慣になりました。#6.1
character_voice.kocontent: 독서는 이맘때 시작했다가 황혼이 내려앉기 전에 끝납니다.#0|기나긴 시간 속에서 독서는 이미 습관이 되어버렸죠.#7.1

character_voice.name: 信任-朝晨
character_voice.content: ……分开面包，这是违反教典的行为。#0|但此处并非岛屿，请享用您的自由。#5
character_voice.encontent: ... One should never parcel off the loaf, for it's a violation of the scripture. #0|But we are not on the island. So, please enjoy the freedom.#5
character_voice.twcontent: ……分開麵包，這是違反教典的行為。#0|但此處並非島嶼，請享用您的自由。#5
character_voice.jpcontent: …パンを切るなんて、教典に反する行為です。#0|まぁ、ここは島ではないのでご自由に。#5.3
character_voice.kocontent: ...빵을 가르는 건 교리에 어긋나는 행위입니다.#0|하지만 여기는 섬이 아니니, 마음껏 자유를 누리시죠.#4.2

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: 昼与夜，相互交替，亦是一种平衡。#0|但灯光延长白昼，夺掠夜晚，于是人们不再享有纯粹的公平。#6.7
character_voice.encontent: The alternation of day and night maintains the balance of the world. #0|However, when electric light prolongs the day and eats into the night, the balance is gone, followed by the fairness.#4
character_voice.twcontent: 晝與夜，相互交替，亦是一種平衡。#0|但燈光延長白晝，奪掠夜晚，於是人們不再享有純粹的公平。#6.7
character_voice.jpcontent: 昼と夜は互いに交代することにより、均衡を保つものです。#0|ですが、いつしか明かりが昼を伸ばし、夜を奪い取るようになりました。そして、人々は純粋な公平性を受けられなくなってしまったのです。#7.8
character_voice.kocontent: 낮과 밤이 서로 교차하는 현상 역시 일종의 균형입니다.#0|하지만 조명의 힘이 밤의 시간을 빼앗아 버리면서, 사람들도 더는 순수한 공정을 누리지 못하게 되었죠.#6.1

character_voice.name: 信任-夜暮
character_voice.content: 这里的昼夜并不分明，但我灵魂的潮汐提醒此刻该是入睡的时候……#0|我困了。#8.8
character_voice.encontent: It is hard to tell the time here in the suitcase, but the ebb and flow of my soul remind me that it is time for bed ... #0|Tiredness caught up with me.#7.6
character_voice.twcontent: 這裡的晝夜並不分明，但我靈魂的潮汐提醒此刻該是入睡的時候……#0|我睏了。#8.8
character_voice.jpcontent: ここでは昼と夜の区別がつきません。しかし魂の潮汐が今は休息の時間だと知らせてくれます…#0|おやすみなさい。#16
character_voice.kocontent: 여긴 낮밤이 불분명하지만 제 영혼의 파도가 지금은 잘 시간이라고 알려주는군요...#0|졸리네요.#11

character_voice.name: 信任-夜暮
character_voice.content: 这里的昼夜并不分明，但我灵魂的潮汐提醒此刻该是入睡的时候……#0|我困了。#8.8
character_voice.encontent: It is hard to tell the time here in the suitcase, but the ebb and flow of my soul remind me that it is time for bed ... #0|Tiredness caught up with me.#7.6

character_voice.name: 帽檐与发鬓
character_voice.content: 每当深夜，海鸥会从岛屿的边缘向内，飞入我的卧室，#0|循着闪光从桌面上取走这顶头冠。#6.4|次日清晨，我会散步至它们筑巢的崖壁，再次取回。#11|一日又一日，日日往复。#17.3
character_voice.encontent: Every night, the seagulls fly into my bedroom from the edge of the island. #0|They follow the glint of the crown and snatch it away. #5.5|The next morning, I walk to the cliff and take it back from their nest. #9|Day after day, again and again.#13.6
character_voice.twcontent: 每當深夜，海鷗會從島嶼的邊緣向內，飛入我的臥室，#0|循著閃光從桌面上取走這頂頭冠。#6.4|次日清晨，我會散步至它們築巢的崖壁，再次取回。#11|一日又一日，日日往復。#17.3
character_voice.jpcontent: カモメは深夜になると島の縁から内側へと飛び、そして私の寝室にきて、#0|光り輝くこの王冠を奪っていきます。#8.5|だから私は毎朝あの子たちの巣がある断崖まで、取り返しに行くのです。#13.7|毎日、毎日、毎日です。#22.7
character_voice.kocontent: 늦은 밤이면 갈매기들이 섬 끝에서 제 침실 안쪽으로 날아와#0|반짝이는 불빛을 따라 탁자 위에 놓인 이 관을 가져갑니다.#7.6|그러면 다음 날 아침, 갈매기 둥지가 있는 절벽으로 가서 이걸 다시 찾아오죠.#15|하루 또 하루, 매일 그렇게 반복됩니다.#23.5

character_voice.content: 这是一块空隙，37曾论证过，它是一个等腰三角形。#0
character_voice.encontent: The uncovered area on my chest happens to be in the shape of an isosceles triangle, as 37 proved it.#0
character_voice.twcontent: 這是一塊空隙，37曾論證過，它是一個等腰三角形。#0
character_voice.jpcontent: そこは小さな隙間。３７の論証どおり、二等辺三角形です。#0
character_voice.kocontent: 이건 틈입니다. 37이 논증한 바 있듯이, 이등변 삼각형이죠.#0

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 喜悦，带来欢欣之物与行，#0|根据人的不同而产生不同，#5.1|我的朋友们有的爱好数学，有的偏爱辩论，而有的则是重视规则……#8.7|当我完成职责，返回我的房间独处时，喜悦亦与我同在。#17.6
character_voice.encontent: Hobby, the source of one's pleasure, #0|varies from person to person. #3.1|One of my friends has a love for numbers, one is drunk in the beauty and power of words, and one is the defender of rules ... #5.8|I also find myself immersed in joy when I'm alone in the room after a day's work.#14.7
character_voice.twcontent: 喜悅，帶來歡欣之物與行，#0|根據人的不同而產生不同，#5.1|我的朋友們有的愛好數學，有的偏愛辯論，而有的則是重視規則……#8.7|當我完成職責，返回我的房間獨處時，喜悅亦與我同在。#17.6
character_voice.jpcontent: 喜び――それをもたらすものや出来事は、#0|人の個性によって変わります。#5|私の友人には数学が好きな人もいれば、弁論が好きな人、規律を重んじるのが好きな人もいます…#8.6|職務を果たしたあと、誰もいない部屋に戻った時が私にとって一番の喜びなのです。#20.8
character_voice.kocontent: 기쁨, 사람마다#0|기쁨을 주는 물건이나 행동이 모두 다릅니다.#2.7|어떤 친구는 수학을 좋아하고, 어떤 친구는 토론을 좋아하며, 어떤 친구는 규칙을 중시합니다...#6.6|전 업무를 마치고 방으로 돌아가 혼자만의 시간을 가지는 그 순간에 가장 큰 기쁨을 느낍니다.#18.9

character_voice.name: 赞赏
character_voice.content: 您充分地明白个人空间的必要性，这是一种高贵的美德。#0
character_voice.encontent: I appreciate your understanding on the importance of personal space. It is a valuable virtue.#0
character_voice.twcontent: 您充分地明白個人空間的必要性，這是一種高貴的美德。#0
character_voice.jpcontent: あなたは個人空間の必要性を十分にわかっていらっしゃる。気高い美徳を持っている証拠です。#0
character_voice.kocontent: 당신은 사적 공간의 필요성을 잘 알고 있군요. 고귀한 미덕입니다.#0

character_voice.name: 亲昵
character_voice.content: 如果您方便的话，请为我取消明日下午三时之前的会面与工作……#0|是的，我需要必要的安宁时刻，用以安抚损耗的神识。#7.7
character_voice.encontent: If you don't mind, please cancel the meetings and work before 3 p.m. tomorrow for me ... #0|Yes, I wish to be left alone, just for a brief peace of mind.#5.3
character_voice.twcontent: 如果您方便的話，請為我取消明日下午三時之前的會面與工作……#0|是的，我需要必要的安寧時刻，用以安撫損耗的神識。#7.7
character_voice.jpcontent: もしよければ、明日午後三時の面会と業務をキャンセルしていただけませんか…#0|精神的損傷を癒すために、どうしても静かな時間が必要なのです。#9

character_voice.content: 岛上的先贤曾以铁锤击打砧板，#0|而后，自然音阶在量化中抵至和谐。#4.3
character_voice.encontent: The wise ones on this island used to strike the iron ingots.#0|After years of careful arrangements and calculations, the clanging sound became music.#4.5
character_voice.twcontent: 島上的先賢曾以鐵錘擊打砧板，#0|而後，自然音階在量化中抵至和諧。#4.3
character_voice.jpcontent: 島の先賢たちはかつて鉄槌でまな板を打ち、#0|自然音階の量化によって調和を生み出したのです。#5.5
character_voice.kocontent: 섬의 선현은 과거 쇠망치로 도마를 때렸습니다.#0|그렇게 자연음계는 계량화되어 조화를 이루게 되었죠.#5.7

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 岛上的先贤曾以铁锤击打砧板，#0|而后，自然音阶在量化中抵至和谐。#4.3
character_voice.encontent: The wise ones on this island used to strike the iron ingots.#0|After years of careful arrangements and calculations, the clanging sound became music.#4.5

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 岛屿周边的海鸥善于行窃，狡黠而敏捷，#0|它们似乎更加偏好于盗窃方形的、纤长的金色几何体……#5.2
character_voice.encontent: The seagulls on the island are clever, cunning, and experienced burglars. #0|They seem to have a preference for stealing those thin, golden, and rectangular objects ...#5.3
character_voice.twcontent: 島嶼周邊的海鷗善於行竊，狡黠而敏捷，#0|它們似乎更加偏好於盜竊方形的、纖長的金色幾何體……#5.2
character_voice.jpcontent: 島周辺のカモメはずる賢く、機敏に動き回るうえによく人の物を盗ります。#0|あの子たちは四角くて細長い金色の幾何体を好む傾向にあるのです…#9.8
character_voice.kocontent: 섬 주변의 갈매기들은 뭐든 잘 훔쳐 갑니다. 교활하고 민첩하죠.#0|녀석들은 사각형의 길쭉한 황금빛 기하학 형체를 더 좋아하는 것 같더군요...#8.4

character_voice.name: 独白
character_voice.content: 于是，十全十美的悲剧发生了。#0
character_voice.encontent: At last, a perfect tragedy.#0
character_voice.twcontent: 於是，十全十美的悲劇發生了。#0
character_voice.jpcontent: こうして、完璧な悲劇が起きる。#0

character_voice.name: 入队
character_voice.content: 这是您的诉求吗？#0
character_voice.encontent: Are you seeking my service?#0
character_voice.jpcontent: それがあなたのお願いですか？#0

character_voice.name: 战前
character_voice.content: 义务所在。#0
character_voice.encontent: My duty lies with you.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: 私にお任せを。#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 缄默之时。#0
character_voice.encontent: The moment of silence.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: 無声の<marktop=とき>時間</marktop>。#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 谈论之时。#0
character_voice.encontent: The moment of utterance.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: 弁論の<marktop=とき>時間</marktop>。#0

character_voice.name: 择选高阶咒语
character_voice.content: 倾听之时。#0
character_voice.encontent: Time for ears to listen.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: 清聴の<marktop=とき>時間</marktop>。#0

character_voice.name: 择选至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 探讨真理。#0
character_voice.encontent: Time for tongues to speak of truth.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: 真理を求めて。#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 从阅读中获益。#0
character_voice.encontent: Benefit from reading.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: 書見のうちに収穫あり。#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 从沉默中领悟。#0
character_voice.encontent: Learn from silence.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: 沈黙のうちに答えあり。#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 我们身处长夜。#0
character_voice.encontent: We walk in long nights.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: 私たちは<marktop=とこ>常</marktop><marktop=よ>夜</marktop>にいる。#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 直至炬火升起。#0
character_voice.encontent: Until the torch is lit.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: かがり火があがるまで。#0

character_voice.name: 召唤至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 你们的灵魂已倾向“过度”，它们亟须修正。#0
character_voice.encontent: The scale of your soul has tilted. The balance needs to be restored.#0
character_voice.twcontent: 你們的靈魂已傾向“過度”，它們亟須修正。#0
character_voice.jpcontent: あなたたちの魂は「あまりに」偏っている。早急に修正しないと。#0
character_voice.kocontent: 여러분의 영혼은 '과도하게' 치우쳐 있어요. 바로잡아야만 합니다.#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅰ
character_voice.encontent: Emm.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: んっ。#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅱ
character_voice.jpcontent: うぅっ…#0

character_voice.name: 战斗胜利
character_voice.content: 如此，我先回去了。#0
character_voice.encontent: Victory secured. I should excuse myself.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: それでは、私はこれで。#0

character_voice.name: 战斗胜利
character_voice.content: 如此，我先回去了。#0
character_voice.encontent: Victory secured. I should excuse myself.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: それでは、私はこれで。#0

character_voice.name: 洞悉
character_voice.content: 完满之上，是否还有完满？#0
character_voice.encontent: Is there another level of perfection upon perfection?#0
character_voice.twcontent: 完滿之上，是否還有完滿？#0
character_voice.jpcontent: 完璧より上など存在するのでしょうか？#0
character_voice.kocontent: 완벽 위에 그보다 더한 완벽이 있을까요?#0

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: 背向火光的影绰，我们从此寻着方向。#0
character_voice.encontent: Turning against the fire in the cave, we see the true lights.#0
character_voice.twcontent: 背向火光的影綽，我們從此尋著方向。#0
character_voice.jpcontent: 暁の影を背に、我々は行くべき方向を探し求める。#0
character_voice.kocontent: 우리는 불빛의 그림자를 등진 채 방향을 찾고 있습니다.#0

character_voice.name: 入队
character_voice.content: 并非本职，但已经熟练。#0
character_voice.encontent: Though this isn't my calling, I find myself content in my growing aptitude.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: 本職ではありませんが、慣れています。#0

character_voice.name: 战前
character_voice.content: 争斗的意义在于？#0
character_voice.encontent: To what end is strife perpetrated?#0
character_voice.jpcontent: 争いの意味とは？#0
character_voice.kocontent: 어떤 목적을 위해 갈등이 계속되는 것인가요?#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 燃起火吧。#0
character_voice.encontent: Must wrath be spoken through fire?#0
character_voice.jpcontent: ならば、火を起こそう。#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 真理如光。#0
character_voice.encontent: Truth is a light to be followed.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: 真理は光。#0

character_voice.name: 择选高阶咒语
character_voice.content: 牛皮上的黄金律言。#0
character_voice.encontent: So much for that gold-inked wisdom.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: 牛皮に記されし黄金の<marktop=しんげん>箴言</marktop>。#0

character_voice.name: 择选至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 慎用狄俄尼索斯之名。#0
character_voice.encontent: Prudence is advised when calling upon Dionysus.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: ディオニュソスの名、慎んで口にするように。#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 惨剧一隅。#0
character_voice.encontent: A tragedy to remember.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: 惨劇の片鱗。#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 铭记这教训。#0
character_voice.encontent: A truth to heed.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: この教訓を胸に。#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 指明前路。#0
character_voice.encontent: Walk the path it illuminates.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: 前途を指し示せ。#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 照亮无知长夜。#0
character_voice.encontent: Leave the night of ignorance.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: <marktop=むみょう>無明</marktop>の<marktop=じょうや>長夜</marktop>に光を。#0

character_voice.name: 召唤至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 认知到错误，往往在毁灭之后。#0
character_voice.encontent: The lesson is learned only when the price is paid.#0
character_voice.twcontent: 認知到錯誤，往往在毀滅之後。#0
character_voice.jpcontent: 誤りの認識は、壊滅のあとにやってくる。#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 荒谬。#0
character_voice.encontent: This is absurd.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: 不条理な。#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 远不及头疼。#0
character_voice.encontent: Not nearly as bad as the headaches.#0
character_voice.jpcontent: 頭を抱えるほどでは…#0

character_voice.name: 战斗胜利
character_voice.content: 可以庆祝，但会饮也需克制。#0
character_voice.encontent: Celebrate to the fullest, yes, but take care with the flow of wine.#0
character_voice.twcontent: 可以慶祝，但會飲也需克制。#0
character_voice.jpcontent: 祝うのは構いませんが、飲酒はほどほどに。#0
character_voice.kocontent: 축하도 좋지만 절제해서 마시는 것도 중요합니다.#0

character_voice.name: 洞悉
character_voice.content: 我们观览了无数场悲剧的残骸，#0|而离完满仍然遥远。#4
character_voice.encontent: We have viewed the wreckage of countless tragedies, #0|yet still, perfection eludes us.#3.1
character_voice.twcontent: 我們觀覽了無數場悲劇的殘骸，#0|而離完滿仍然遙遠。#4
character_voice.jpcontent: 我々は度重なる悲劇の残骸を見届けてきましたが、#0|今もなお完璧には程遠い。#5.6
character_voice.kocontent: 우리는 수많은 비극의 잔해를 보아왔지만,#0| 여전히 완벽은 우리에게서 멀리 떨어져 있습니다.#4.4

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: 背向火光的影绰，我们从此寻着方向。#0
character_voice.encontent: Turning against the fire in the cave, we see the true lights.#0
character_voice.twcontent: 背向火光的影綽，我們從此尋著方向。#0
character_voice.jpcontent: 暁の影を背に、我々は行くべき方向を探し求める。#0
character_voice.kocontent: 우리는 불빛의 그림자를 등진 채 방향을 찾고 있습니다.#0

character_voice.name: 入队
character_voice.content: 我并不擅长极致的图式。#0
character_voice.encontent: I will not lead by absolute formalism.#0

character_voice.name: 战前
character_voice.content: 对于这起纷争，我没有看法。#0
character_voice.encontent: I have no comment on this conflict.#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 来自天上的声音。#0
character_voice.encontent: The voice from above.#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 用耳朵去演奏。#0
character_voice.encontent: Follow your ears.#0

character_voice.name: 择选高阶咒语
character_voice.content: 真理在无声中。#0
character_voice.encontent: Find music in silent numbers.#0

character_voice.name: 择选至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 献以真诚的音符。#0
character_voice.encontent: To sing the notes we truly mean.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 使愚者清醒。#0
character_voice.encontent: To enlighten the foolish.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 缄默亦有重量。#0
character_voice.encontent: Silence, too, carries strength.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 应当歌颂光。#0
character_voice.encontent: Light be praised.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 一次和声。#0
character_voice.encontent: A chord.#0

character_voice.name: 召唤至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 望你从虚无的水面折返，而非沉溺。#0
character_voice.encontent: May you turn from your reflection and not drown in it.#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 一点苦痛。#0
character_voice.encontent: Only a little pain.#0

character_voice.name: 战斗胜利
character_voice.content: 很荣幸与各位合奏，再见。#0
character_voice.encontent: It was an honor performing with you all. Farewell.#0

character_voice.name: 洞悉
character_voice.content: 我与倒影之间，没有休止符。#0
character_voice.encontent: My reflection and I are connected yet independent, like two mirrored melodies linked by a canon.#0

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: 背向火光的影绰，我们从此寻着方向。#0
character_voice.encontent: Turning against the fire in the cave, we see the true lights.#0

skin.name: 何时何地
skin.skinDescription: 历经八场阴谋，失去远方归所，他登至台前。
skin.skinStory:
20世纪末，曾经风靡全球的《街头干探》推出新作《神秘的数字》。一时间，崭新的街机遍布了大街小巷，成为了许多玩家茶余饭后的谈资。
“嘿，你们知道吗？我见到那个‘神秘人’的原型了！”
不知何时起，围绕着某位爱琴海的岛上访客，一则流言飞快传播开去。玩家谈论着他和那名人气角色的相似度：深色的风衣、金属的假面、神秘的身世，还有单一字符组成的名字。
据不愿透露姓名的基金会员工称，曾有人建议当事者出面澄清，但是遭到了拒绝。有趣的是，这份拒绝和回避造就了同原作一般的神秘氛围，时至今日，这条“都市传说”仍为众多玩家津津乐道。

skin.name: 于火中得见
skin.skinDescription: 历史是巨大的废墟。昔日既成的一切，如今已只余烬土。

skin.name: 孤独赞美诗
skin.skinDescription: 孤独是一汪池塘，你的心即是泉眼。
skin.skinStory:
那条名为“命运”的河流，曾经由无数人的书写。
在剧作家的笔下，这条河流足以溺死奥菲利亚。她还没能来得及拥有独立的灵魂，便因无意志的顺从成为了傀儡，消失在了王权与父权的阴影之下。
在诗人的笔下，这条河流平缓如镜，足以映出水仙花的倒影。名为纳西瑟斯的少年沉溺于自我的映照，只为了拥抱河畔边那个完美的虚相。
隐者涉水而行，他既不随波逐流，也不因水中的呼唤而止步。他恪守自身的法度，始终与诸事诸相保持着既定的距离。
孤独与他成为了一种永恒，他是河流中一块沉默的礁石，望着那些分流而去的河水。
无论这些河水将要流向何方，礁石总会在原地等待。
skin.subTitle: singlebg_lang/txt_skinhandbook_singlebg/skinsuitdetailview_title_taluo.png

1041002.content: 如果你愿意的话——请务必。
和朋友共度的时间固然美妙，但如果能独自待上片刻确实是更好的。
只是思考。但当念头出现，我并未捕捉它们，而是开始计算有多少只鸟从天边飞过。
只是沉浸在此刻的静寂之中。

1072024.content: 既定之物……那是众多戏剧的主题。
在众神写定的结局前挣扎，最终无法逃脱；亦或书中的英雄突破命运，但故事的写法也早已流于烂俗。
是的，我读过这两种故事。
您充满信心，这是一件好事。
命运是一种无法替代的感受。

1093005.speaker: 葛天
1093005.content: 如是说来，你所习得之物、记忆之事，远者已逾千百年？
它们来自过去的“6”们，我只是承载者中的一个。

1093005.speaker: 葛天
1093005.content: 我亦曾见过几度世事荣衰……也曾于骨上读得祸福。然，终是身在山中。

1093005.speaker: 葛天
1093005.content: 不，既然你我已俱在此处，此中滋味已不需我赘言了，是么？
